description: What stays a pass beside an empty file: a file of only a todo test, of only a skipped test and of a skipped describe with a test inside each collected something, so each has test results and Jest's scheduler (TestScheduler.ts onResult) does not turn it into "Your test suite must contain at least one test."; the file of an empty describe next to them still fails with that text. The tree is data (D13). One Jest worker, the default reporter and --json.
